cookies.title: Cookies 🍪
cookies.bannerText: We use necessary cookies so you stay signed in. To protect our forms from spam we'd also like to use Google reCAPTCHA. This sends data to Google, and Google sets cookies.
cookies.bannerChoice: Without consent you can still view the site, but the sign-up and guest forms need reCAPTCHA. You can change your choice any time via “Cookies” at the bottom of the page. More in our <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
cookies.settingsIntro: Choose which services we may use. Your choice is stored in your browser. Details are in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
cookies.necessaryText: Keep you signed in and remember your language and this cookie choice.
cookies.recaptchaText: Protects sign-up and the guest list from spam. Provider: Google Ireland Ltd. This sends data (including your IP address) to Google, and Google sets cookies. Without reCAPTCHA these forms can't be used.

home.metaTitle: Free Online Invitation & Guest List – GASTZILLA
home.title: Create a free online invitation & guest list
home.tagline: No more RSVP chaos in the group chat.
home.intro: Create an invitation page for a birthday, wedding, barbecue or office party in minutes. Share the link – your guests reply yes or no themselves. Your first event is free.
home.benefitReadyText: Pick a title, date, location and design – and your invitation page is ready.
home.benefitNoAccountText: Date polls, yes and no replies, plus-ones, things to bring and messages – all through the link.
home.benefitShareText: WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram, email – with ready-made texts to copy and share.
home.aboutLead: More about the idea behind GASTZILLA:
home.stepCreate: Create an event, pick a design – set the date or let guests vote on it
home.stepShare: Share the invitation link – the matching invitation text is already written
home.stepTrack: Keep track of every yes and no – with an email for each one
home.noEvents: You haven't created any events yet.
home.freeEventUsed: You've already used your free event. You can unlock more events.
